At a glance

The same Mini for a stronger 3 × 32 A line, with an RFID card reader. If your line or car can’t do 22 kW, it is set to 11 kW.

  • Tethered 5 m Type 2 cable: park and plug in.
  • Up to 22 kW on a 3 × 32 A line. Most cars take at most 11 kW on AC, and the charger can be set lower.
  • RFID reader: charging starts with your card, handy in a shared garage.
  • Built-in 6 mA DC fault detection, so a Type A RCD in the panel is usually enough.
  • Dynamic load management: the charger slows down when the house draws more, so the main fuse doesn’t trip.
  • Wi-Fi, Ethernet and Bluetooth, OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1.

In the box and installation

In the box

Charger with 5 m cable, wall bracket, 2 RFID cards, manual in Serbian.

What installation needs

For 11 kW you need a three-phase 3 × 16 A line; for 22 kW, 3 × 32 A. Basic installation next to your panel (up to 2 m of cable, RCD and breaker) starts at RSD 24,000.
